verdict.rationale: uv is a CLI tool with no HTTP API, so its documented CLI reference is the closest analogue to an API reference (uv-probe-4). The docs include many copy-pasteable console examples with expected output (e.g. `uv init example`, `uvx pycowsay`, `uv tool install ruff`) that users can run locally. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples, and no OpenAPI spec exists (uv-probe-3). Missing for 10: an interactive or explorable reference interface, in-docs runnable or sandboxed examples, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
